source.enumeration_basis: Every line of source/codigo-penal-1940.txt that opens an article ('Art. N', 'Art N', 'Art. N-X', 'Art. N-X-Y', revoked ones included), restricted to this part: Parte Especial Títulos VIII–IX, arts. 250–288-A (incolumidade pública, paz pública). Generated mechanically by the conductor; units are articles.
source.enumeration_note: ONE PART (g4b) of twelve; registers/merge-parts.py merges them into registers/encoding-roadmap.json, whose enumeration is complete (434 units, every article number 1–361).

units.title: Incêndio
units.note: Caput (the crime, consummated or attempted, art. 14), § 1º I and II (increase of one third, intentional form only, fork F-g4b-04; reaches the fine, F-g4b-03), § 2º (culpable form and its pena). Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Common danger read as an element (F-g4b-01). The 1940 text: answers for any date. Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Explosão
units.note: Caput and § 1º (the substance chooses the pena: dynamite or analogous, or another; the modes read with the substance, F-g4b-05), § 2º (increase of one third, reading art. 250 § 1º, I and II), § 3º (culpable explosion, a preceito depending on the substance). Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Uso de gás tóxico ou asfixiante
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted) and parágrafo único (culpable form). Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Fabrico, fornecimento, aquisição posse ou transporte de explosivos ou gás tóxico, ou asfixiante
units.note: The five verbs, the three objects and 'sem licença da autoridade'; intentional only (art. 18, parágrafo único). No danger element: the Code presumes it. Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). 'substância ou engenho explosivo' is two members. From 23.12.2003 Lei nº 10.826/2003, art. 16, § 1º, III takes possessing or making an explosive device (M-sweep-c-32, fork F-sweep-c-18, derogacaoParcial): such a fact refuses by name, as that law is not encoded; the rest of art. 253 stands. Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Inundação
units.note: The crime, intentional (consummated or attempted) or culpable; the preceito depends on the fact ('no caso de dolo ... no caso de culpa', PLAN § 2.2.1 shape 7). Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Perigo de inundação
units.note: Remover, destruir ou inutilizar an obstacle or work against flooding, exposing others to common danger; intentional only. 'em prédio próprio ou alheio' carried inert. Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Desabamento ou desmoronamento
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted) and parágrafo único (culpable form). Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Subtração, ocultação ou inutilização de material de salvamento
units.note: Both modes (taking, hiding or disabling rescue equipment; preventing or hindering the service), 'por ocasião de ... desastre ou calamidade' read with both; intentional only. Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Formas qualificadas de crime de perigo comum
units.note: The four arms: intentional crime with serious injury (+1/2) or death (x2); culpable crime with any injury (+1/2) or death (art. 121 § 3º's pena, borrowed and named for its source, +1/3). Art. 19 and the preterintentional reading (F-g4b-02) through `imputação do resultado`; 'de natureza grave' includes gravíssima (F-g4b-06); a death with an injury takes the death's arm (F-g4b-07). Applied to Capítulo I directly, to arts. 260-262 by art. 263, to Capítulo III by art. 285. Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Difusão de doença ou praga
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted) and parágrafo único (culpable form, 'ou multa'). Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). The caput's intentional form is tacitly revoked by Lei nº 9.605/1998, art. 61, milder and so retroactive (M-sweep-c-31, fork F-sweep-c-17, revogadoSalvoCulposa): its words stay encoded, the crime and penalty refuse by name; the culpable form stands. Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Perigo de desastre ferroviário
units.note: Caput with incisos I to IV (consummated or attempted), § 1º (disaster: its own pena), § 2º (culpable, only with a disaster), § 3º (what 'estrada de ferro' means). No danger element beyond inciso IV's words (F-g4b-08). Art. 258 through art. 263 when a disaster occurred. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Atentado contra a segurança de transporte marítimo, fluvial ou aéreo
units.note: Caput (both modes), § 1º (wreck: its own pena), § 2º (the fine added, intentional forms only), § 3º (culpable, only with a wreck). Art. 258 through art. 263 when the wreck occurred. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Atentado contra a segurança de outro meio de transporte
units.note: Caput, § 1º (disaster: reclusão), § 2º (culpable, only with a disaster). Art. 258 through art. 263 when a disaster occurred. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Forma qualificada
units.note: `a forma do art. 258 que o art. 263 faz incidir`: art. 258 for arts. 260-262 only 'no caso de desastre ou sinistro'. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Arremesso de projétil
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted; intentional only) and parágrafo único (injury of any grade: its own pena; death: art. 121 § 3º's pena plus one third, the borrowed preceito of cp-g4b-perigo-comum.l4). Art. 19 and F-g4b-02 as for art. 258. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Atentado contra a segurança de serviço de utilidade pública
units.note: Caput and parágrafo único (increase of one third to one half), the paragraph in force from 7.12.1967 (Lei nº 5.346/1967, art. 4º: 30 days after DOU 7.11.1967); before it the cause does not exist. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Vigência
units.note: Caput (1940 words: any date) and § 1º (in force 2.4.2013, Lei nº 12.737/2012; 'interrompe', not 'perturba'), the pena and § 2º I-II (doubling, reaching the fine, F-g4b-03) in Lei nº 15.397/2026's wording: penalty rules refuse for facts before 4.5.2026, and the causes refuse by a refusal of their own for 29.7.2025 to 3.5.2026, when Lei nº 15.181/2025's § 2º (not in the source; S-sweep-c-04) governed. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Epidemia
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted; definition 1940, any date; pena Lei nº 8.072/1990's, refusing before 26.7.1990), § 1º (death doubles, art. 19 and F-g4b-02), § 2º (culpable, a preceito depending on whether death resulted; 1940, any date). Excepted from art. 258 by art. 285, and asserted so. Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-epidemia-e-agua-testes.l4.

units.title: Infração de medida sanitária preventiva
units.note: Caput and parágrafo único (+1/3 for a public-health official or a physician, pharmacist, dentist or nurse; not a veterinarian). 'determinação do poder público' is any federated entity's act within its sphere: STF Tema 1246, M-sweep-c-08, fork F-sweep-c-04, read through the issuing entity. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-epidemia-e-agua-testes.l4.

units.title: Omissão de notificação de doença
units.note: The physician's failure to report a disease of compulsory notification; an omission, so no attempt (F-g4b-11); intentional only. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-epidemia-e-agua-testes.l4.

units.title: Envenenamento de água potável ou de substância alimentícia ou medicinal
units.note: Caput and § 1º (dealing in the poisoned water or substance, 'a mesma pena'), § 2º (culpable). Definition 1940, any date; the caput's pena (and § 1º's) Lei nº 8.072/1990's, refusing before 26.7.1990. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-epidemia-e-agua-testes.l4.

units.title: Corrupção ou poluição de água potável
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted) and parágrafo único (culpable). Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-epidemia-e-agua-testes.l4.

units.title: Pena - detenção, de dois meses a um ano.
units.note: Caput, § 1º-A (dealing in the caput's product, F-g4b-14), § 1º (drinks), § 2º (culpable). All Lei nº 9.677/1998 (in force 3.7.1998) wording: the crime and the pena refuse for an earlier fact. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-alimentos-e-medicamentos-testes.l4.

units.title: Pena - detenção, de 1 (um) a 2 (dois) anos, e multa. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 9.677, de 2.7.1998)
units.note: Caput, § 1º, § 1º-A (the products included), § 1º-B I-VI, § 2º (culpable). STF Tema 1003 (M-sweep-c-03, binding): § 1º-B, I alone takes the repristinated reclusão 1-3 anos e multa, for every verb of § 1º (F-g4b-12); with a falsification or inciso II, III, IV or VI, 10-15 (F-g4b-13). § 1º-B, V alone: the STJ's Corte Especial declared its penalty unconstitutional naming no substitute (M-sweep-c-29), and the penalty refuses (F-sweep-c-16); I with V takes inciso I's penalty. Lei nº 9.677/1998 (in force 3.7.1998) wording: refuses for an earlier fact. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-alimentos-e-medicamentos-testes.l4.

units.title: Emprego de processo proibido ou de substância não permitida
units.note: The crime (1940 words, any date; 'não expressamente permitida' read with every item, F-g4b-15); the pena is Lei nº 9.677/1998 (in force 3.7.1998) and refuses for an earlier fact. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-alimentos-e-medicamentos-testes.l4.

units.title: Invólucro ou recipiente com falsa indicação
units.note: The crime and pena, both Lei nº 9.677/1998 (in force 3.7.1998) wording: refuse for an earlier fact. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-alimentos-e-medicamentos-testes.l4.

units.title: Produto ou substância nas condições dos dois artigos anteriores
units.note: The crime (1940 words, any date; 'nas condições dos arts. 274 e 275' read as either condition, F-g4b-16); the pena is Lei nº 9.677/1998 (in force 3.7.1998) and refuses for an earlier fact. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-alimentos-e-medicamentos-testes.l4.

units.title: Substância destinada à falsificação
units.note: The crime and pena, both Lei nº 9.677/1998 (in force 3.7.1998) wording: refuse for an earlier fact. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-alimentos-e-medicamentos-testes.l4.

units.title: Outras substâncias nocivas à saúde pública
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted) and parágrafo único (culpable). Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-alimentos-e-medicamentos-testes.l4.

units.title: Substância avariada
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 8.137/1990. Carried as a labelled stub, `o art. 279, revogado`, with the revocation note as the source prints it (phrasebook entry 9.1); nothing reads it. The conductor had set this unit out-of-scope; g4b moved it to inert when the stub landed.

units.title: Medicamento em desacordo com receita médica
units.note: Caput ('ou multa', an alternative) and parágrafo único (culpable). Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-alimentos-e-medicamentos-testes.l4.

units.title: Comércio, posse ou uso de entorpecente ou substância que determine dependência física ou psíquica
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 6.368/1976. Carried as a labelled stub, `o art. 281, revogado` (phrasebook entry 9.1); nothing reads it. The conductor had set this unit out-of-scope, with a title scraped from the line before; g4b corrected the title to the source's rubric (line 1966) and moved the unit to inert.

units.title: Pena - detenção, de dois meses a um ano.
units.note: Caput and § 5º (the crime; 'exercer' read as habitual, F-g4b-10; no attempt, F-g4b-11), § 1º (fine for profit), §§ 2º-4º (the other crimes the agent also answers for, as a list). Lei nº 15.425/2026's wording: the crime and every rule refuse for a fact before 8.6.2026. Not reached by art. 258 through art. 285 (F-g4b-09). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-exercicio-ilegal-testes.l4.

units.title: Charlatanismo
units.note: The crime (consummated or attempted) and pena. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-exercicio-ilegal-testes.l4.

units.title: Curandeirismo
units.note: Caput with incisos I-III ('habitualmente' read into all three through 'Exercer', F-g4b-10; no attempt) and parágrafo único (fine when paid). Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-exercicio-ilegal-testes.l4.

units.title: Forma qualificada
units.note: `a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`: art. 258 for every crime of Capítulo III, NOTHING for art. 267 ('salvo quanto ao definido no art. 267') and for art. 282 (fork F-g4b-09). Every Capítulo III module calls it. Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-forma-qualificada-testes.l4 and in each Capítulo III tests module.

units.title: Incitação ao crime
units.note: Caput ('crime', not contravenção; a crime the incitement points to, F-g4b-17; consummated or attempted) and parágrafo único (in force 1.12.2021, Lei nº 14.197/2021: before it, not a crime). 'ou multa', an alternative. Tests in cp-g4b-paz-publica-testes.l4.

units.title: Apologia de crime ou criminoso
units.note: The crime (a criminal fact that happened, or its author, F-g4b-18), read down by ADPF 187 (M-sweep-c-04, binding): the advocacy of drug legalisation, public demonstrations included, is excluded (`excluída pela interpretação conforme (ADPF 187)`), for every fact. Tests in cp-g4b-paz-publica-testes.l4.

units.title: Associação Criminosa
units.note: Caput (a stable bond, F-g4b-19; three or more associates counted as persons, punishable or not, F-g4b-21), § 1º (up to half: armed, F-g4b-20, or a child or adolescent on the date of the fact), § 2º (soliciting or hiring a crime from a member; in force 30.10.2025; the solicited crime's penalty applies too). Lei nº 12.850/2013's wording, in force 19.9.2013: before it the article refuses; § 1º is 12.850's parágrafo único renumbered by Lei nº 15.245/2025 (F-g4b-24). Lei nº 8.072/1990, art. 8º (M-sweep-c-30, binding): reclusão 3-6 for an association aimed at heinous crimes or torture, and its parágrafo único's decrease of one to two thirds for the associate who denounces the group; for trafficking and terrorism the association falls under special laws not encoded (Lei nº 11.343/2006, art. 35; Lei nº 13.260/2016), and the penalty refuses by name (F-g4b-23), as it does for § 2º with such a crime solicited. Tests in cp-g4b-paz-publica-testes.l4.

units.title: (Incluído dada pela Lei nº 12.720, de 2012)
units.note: The five verbs, the four bands, the purpose; in force 28.9.2012 (Lei nº 12.720/2012): before it, not a crime. The minimum membership the article does not state is the fact supplier's finding (F-g4b-22); no attempt (F-g4b-11). Tests in cp-g4b-paz-publica-testes.l4.
